points.title: {name}'s points
points.refreshFailed: Saved, but the ledger could not be refreshed. Reload the page to see the latest.
points.availableHint: Balance minus points held by pending requests.

adjust.title: Adjust points
adjust.amountInvalid: Enter a whole number of points from 1 to 1,000,000.

reverse.title: Reverse this entry
reverse.explain: This adds an opposite entry. Nothing is deleted, and the reversal can be undone later.

errors.already_reversed: Someone already reversed this entry. The ledger was refreshed.

login.title: Sign in
login.notParent: This account isn't a parent account. The admin is for parents.
login.totpPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.recoveryPrompt: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.
login.recoveryCodesLeft: You have no recovery codes left. Create new ones on your account page. | You have 1 recovery code left. Create new ones on your account page. | You have {count} recovery codes left. Create new ones on your account page.

errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong or was already used. Wait for the next one and try again.
errors.invalidRecovery: That recovery code is wrong or was already used.
errors.rateLimited: Too many failed sign-ins. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong signing in. Try again.

setup.title: Set up Chorecast
setup.body: This server hasn't been set up yet. Open the setup link printed in the server's log to create your household.
setup.invalidToken: This setup link isn't valid any more. The link changes every time the server restarts: open the newest one from the server's log.

household.title: Household
household.name: Household name
household.dayEndHint: Chores left open at the end of the day count as missed. 00:00 means midnight.

owner.title: Your account
owner.intro: You'll be the household's owner: a parent who can also change server settings.
owner.laterHint: You can turn on two-factor sign-in and invite other parents after setup.
owner.usernameInvalid: Usernames are 3-32 lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
owner.passwordTooShort: Use at least 8 characters for your password.

kids.title: Kids
kids.intro: Add the kids who'll use Chorecast. Use a nickname or first name only.
kids.name: Name
kids.pinRequired: Ask for a PIN on shared tablets
kids.laterHint: You can skip this and add or change kids later.
kids.birthDateFuture: A birth date is in the future.

done.devicesBody: Install the Chorecast Android app on each kid's phone or a shared family tablet.
done.pairingLater: Pairing a device with a QR code arrives with the Devices page. You'll find it in the admin.

password.title: Password
password.hint: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else.
password.setHint: You sign in with single sign-on. Add a password to also sign in without it, and to confirm changes like your PIN.

pin.title: Parent PIN
pin.hint: Unlocks parent actions on a shared family tablet without your password.

totp.title: Two-factor sign-in
totp.hint: Ask for a code from an authenticator app (such as Aegis, 2FAS or Google Authenticator) when you sign in.
totp.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
totp.manual: Can't scan it? Enter this key instead:
totp.onHint: You'll need a code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code, to sign in.
totp.saveCodes: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
totp.fileHeader: Chorecast recovery codes. Each code works once.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.hint: Sign in with your household's identity provider (such as Authentik or Keycloak) instead of a password. Link your account once, here.
sso.linkedHint: You can sign in with your identity provider. Your password still works too.

errors.not_linked: That identity provider account isn't linked to a parent. Sign in with your password, then link it on your account page.
errors.already_linked: That identity provider account is already linked to another parent.
errors.expired: Single sign-on took too long or was interrupted. Try again.
errors.denied: The identity provider didn't sign you in.
errors.failed: Single sign-on failed. Try again, or sign in with your password.

parents.title: Parents
parents.resetConfirm: {name} gets a new temporary password and is signed out everywhere. You'll see the password once, to pass on.
parents.disableTotpConfirm: {name} will sign in with just their password until they turn two-factor sign-in on again.
parents.removeConfirm: {name} is signed out everywhere and can't sign in again. Their name stays on past chores and points.
parents.tempBody: Give this password to {name}. They should change it on their account page.
parents.invitesHint: An invite link works once, for 7 days. Send it, or let them scan the QR code.
parents.roleOwner: Owner (also manages server settings and parents)
parents.copyFailed: Couldn't copy; select the link instead.
parents.linkHint: Works once, until {when}. This link isn't shown again.

invite.title: Join your household on Chorecast
invite.noToken: Open the invite link you were sent to join.
invite.invalid: This invite link isn't valid any more. It may have been used, revoked or expired; ask for a new one.
invite.intro: {name} invited you to {household} as a parent.
invite.introOwner: {name} invited you to {household} as an owner.
invite.ssoHint: Or join with your identity provider account. Enter your name above first; a username is optional.

errors.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Choose another.
errors.sso: Joining with single sign-on didn't work. Try again, or create a password instead.

kids.title: Kids
kids.photoHint: A photo replaces the picture below until you remove it. JPEG, PNG or WebP. It's saved straight away.
kids.empty: No kids yet. Add one to get started.
kids.name: Name (nickname or first name)
kids.slugHint: Used in links and scripts, e.g. /kids/sam. Changing it breaks old links.
kids.pinAfterCreate: You can set the PIN after creating the profile.
kids.dayEndHint: Their chores count as missed at this time instead of at the household's day end.
kids.quietHint: No notifications to this kid in this window (it can cross midnight).
kids.schoolHint: Extra quiet time on school days.
kids.archiveConfirm: {name} is hidden, their devices are signed out, and no new chores are scheduled. Their history is kept, and you can unarchive them later.
kids.unarchivedMsg: {name} is back. Pair their devices again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.calendarHint: Changing the timezone, day end or week start reschedules upcoming chores that haven't been started.
settings.allowNegativeHint: When off, a deduction never takes a kid below zero.

visibility.label: What kids see of each other
visibility.private: Private: only their own points and chores
visibility.leaderboard: Family leaderboard: a weekly ranking by points earned

settings.autoApproveHint: Chores can override this. Off means a parent always decides.
settings.defaultMinutes: Chores without an estimate count as
settings.defaultMinutesHint: Fair auto-pick gives a chore to the kid with the least work over the last 7 days, using estimated minutes.
settings.retentionHint: Evidence media is deleted this long after a chore is resolved; the record stays.
settings.graceHint: Chores completed offline count if they were done within this long after the day ended.
settings.streaksHint: A kid earns the bonus when their daily streak reaches this many days. No rows means no streak bonuses.
settings.milestoneDays: Days must be a whole number from 1 to 3650.
settings.milestonePoints: Bonus points must be a whole number from 1 to 100000.
settings.milestoneDuplicate: Each streak length can appear only once.
settings.fieldInvalid: The server rejected a highlighted setting. Check it and save again.
settings.serverHint: Chorecast {version}. These come from environment variables on the server; change them there and restart.

devices.title: Devices
devices.pairHint: Install the Chorecast app, choose “Pair this device”, and scan the code. A kid's own device signs them in directly; a shared family tablet shows everyone's profiles.
devices.localWarning: This server address only works on this computer. Set CHORECAST_PUBLIC_URL to an address phones can reach (for example http://192.168.1.20:8080) and restart the server.
devices.locked: {name} goes back to its profile picker within about 30 seconds.
devices.revokeConfirm: {name} is signed out right away and goes back to the pairing screen. To give it to someone else, pair it again.
devices.listHint: Lock sends a shared tablet back to its profile picker. Devices can't be renamed or moved to another kid: unpair and pair again instead.

chores.title: Chores
chores.empty: No chores yet. Add one to get started.
chores.dueAnytime: Due by the end of the day
chores.name: Name
chores.slotsHint: Add a time for each time it's due on a day it happens (for example 07:00 and 18:00). With no times, it's due by the end of the day. Flexible chores ignore times: they're due by the end of the week.
chores.requiresApproval: A parent approves it before points are given
chores.escalate: Remind parents if it's still open 30 minutes before the day ends (meds, pets)
chores.eligibilityHint: Exceptions to the minimum age: allow a younger kid, or keep a kid off this chore.

errors.name: Give the chore a name.
errors.beforeAfter: Before & after needs at least 2 photos.
errors.checklist: A checklist needs at least one step.

assignment.title: Who does it

modeHints.fixed: Each kid you pick gets their own copy.
modeHints.everyone: Every eligible kid gets their own copy.
modeHints.rotation: One kid at a time, in the order you set.
modeHints.auto: One kid each time: whoever has the least work this week.
modeHints.shared: One copy for the group. Any member can finish it.

kidsHint.rotation: Pick at least one kid, then set the turn order.
kidsHint.auto: Pick the kids to choose from, or none to choose from every kid.
kidsHint.shared: Pick at least two kids for the group.

assignment.noKids: No kids yet. Add a kid first.
assignment.orderHint: The first kid goes first, then the next, and back to the start.

points.completer_takes_all: The kid who finishes it gets all the points
points.split_evenly: Split evenly with the helpers they tag

penalty.all: Every group member gets the penalty

assignment.resetWarning: Changing the mode or the kids restarts the rotation from the first kid.

errors.sharedKids: Pick at least two kids for a shared chore.

serverErrors.mode: Pick a valid way to hand this out.
serverErrors.kidIds: The server rejected the kids you picked. Check them and try again.

schedule.title: Which days

modes.flexible_weekly: A number of times a week

schedule.shortMonths: Months without a day are skipped (no 31st in a 30-day month). Pick “Last day” for the end of every month.
schedule.timesPerWeek: time a week, any day | times a week, any days
schedule.flexibleHint: Each completion earns points. Completions still missing when the week ends count as missed.
schedule.previewNone: Nothing coming up: the schedule has ended or never matches a day.
schedule.byDayEnd: by the end of the day
schedule.byWeekEnd: once by the end of the week | {n} times by the end of the week

summary.monthlyDays: Monthly on day {days} | Every {n} months on day {days}
summary.monthlyNth: The {nth} {day} of every month | The {nth} {day} every {n} months
summary.flexible: Once a week, any day | {n} times a week, any days

errors.endDate: The end date is before the start date.
errors.weekdays: Pick at least one day of the week.
errors.monthDays: Pick at least one day of the month.

review.title: Review
review.bulkAlreadyDecided: {n} chores had already been decided and were removed.
review.bulkFailed: Some chores could not be approved:
review.reasonOrText: Choose a reason or write some feedback.

today.title: Today
today.empty: No chores in the next week.

confirm.reverse: Undo the approval of {chore}? Its points will be taken back.
confirm.excuse: Excuse {chore}? It will not count as missed.
confirm.complete: Mark {chore} done for the kid? Chores that need photos or other proof cannot be completed here.

today.rejectedBefore: Rejected {n} time before | Rejected {n} times before

errors.instance_shared: A shared chore cannot be reassigned.
errors.instance_taken: That kid already has this chore on that day.

audit.intro: Who changed what in the household. Entries are kept for a year.
audit.ownersOnly: Only owners can see the audit log.
